purpose: Compare the two most recent official monthly weighted-average interest rates for one U.S. Treasury security category and classify the month-over-month change.
evidence: U.S. Treasury Fiscal Data — Average Interest Rates on U.S. Treasury Securities
claim_boundaries: the source values are monthly weighted-average rates on outstanding Treasury securities
the result is not a live market yield
the result is not a forecast or investment recommendation
a two-point change classification is not a long-term trend determination
